name: Cecilia Crescent
source:
An old friend and classmate of Suoh's from back when he was a student and has had feelings for him after he saved her back then.

She has a history with Sara that neither one of them want to talk about in front of Suoh for different reasons. A history Suoh is supposed to remember but doesn't.
